name: Disable App Launch Tracking
description: Disables Windows from tracking opened apps to enhance Start menu and search suggestions privacy without impacting regular app usage.

description_i18n.en: Disables Windows from tracking opened apps to enhance Start menu and search suggestions privacy without impacting regular app usage.
description_i18n.de: Stoppt Windows davon, welche Anwendungen Sie öffnen, zu verfolgen. Dies verbessert die Privatsphäre der Vorschläge im Startmenü und bei der Suche ohne Beeinträchtigung des normalen App-Betriebs.
description_i18n.fr: Arrête Windows de suivre les applications que vous ouvrez pour améliorer la confidentialité des suggestions du menu Démarrer et de la recherche, sans affecter l'utilisation normale des applications.

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the registry value Start_TrackProgs under HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced to set it to 0 This disables telemetry regarding which programs are launched
